hypotheses.construction_plan: Instantiate the diagonal template M(theta, theta) with theta=1 to obtain M(1, 1) and with theta=2 to obtain M(2, 2).
required_assumptions: M is a declared binary function symbol and substitution of equal arguments is valid.
hypotheses.rationale: Both terms are diagonal evaluations of the same declared binary function M, so they share the parameterized diagonal form M(theta, theta).
